phases.objective: Make Windows reboot and local Staging startup self-healing, phase-aware and exact-SHA convergent without treating normal boot transients as incidents or rebuilding a healthy local application for Gateway-only drift.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Interactive Windows logon after a reboot with Docker Desktop and local connector runtimes initially stopped.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Docker Desktop is started and proven ready by docker info, local services recover under a bounded deployment lease, Staging and Connector tunnels are classified independently, exact-SHA Gateway drift is repaired component-wise without rebuilding the healthy app, and certification resumes from the convergence boundary with structured state and root-cause evidence.
steps: Start Auto Deploy at interactive logon after a bounded delay with highest privileges, one-minute failure retry and IgnoreNew overlap protection.
Use docker info as the local Docker Engine authority; start Docker Desktop when needed and poll for at most 180 seconds before emitting docker_engine_start_timeout.
Publish a bounded boot/deployment lease so the Health Monitor represents Docker/service starting states as bootstrapping or deploying rather than consecutive incidents.
Verify the five required Compose services and maintain current failure_class separately from last_failure_class historical evidence.
Classify dev.mad4b.com/mcp-dev.mad4b.com Staging ingress independently from connector.mad4b.com Admin Recovery ingress and preserve Cloudflare 1033 as a dedicated connector failure.
Recover legacy connector Scheduled Tasks or service-based connector runtimes through the independent recurring watchdog.
Persist eligibility/build/deployment/service-health/tunnel/convergence/certification phases instead of reducing the run to deployed/certified booleans.

When the local exact-SHA deployment is healthy and only Gateway drift remains, run the read-only schema/governance preflight and the existing governed Activation Worker converger instead of rebuilding the app.
Refresh the app only with --no-build when non-secret Worker origin trust changed, then re-run exact-SHA certification.
Promote failure_class, expected_commit, observed_commit, parent_error and blocking_reason into last-failure.json so the original component failure is not overwritten by a generic launcher error.
assertions: Docker Desktop process existence is never treated as Docker readiness; docker info must succeed.
A normal starting health state within the active lease or boot grace does not increment consecutive_failures.
Current failure_class is cleared after recovery while last_failure_class may preserve historical diagnostics.
Staging cloudflared health does not imply connector.mad4b.com health and Connector 1033 remains independently visible.
Gateway-only drift may invoke only the pre-existing exact-SHA Staging Worker workflow authority and cannot authorize Production, DNS, database, migration or Hostinger mutation.
A healthy exact-SHA local app is not rebuilt solely because Activation Gateway is stale.
Unknown local deployment failures remain fail-closed rather than being reclassified as Gateway-only recovery.
Production mutation remains false and secrets_included remains false.
